explanation: Move one pointer by one link and another by two. They meet exactly when a reachable cycle exists.
correctness: Without a cycle the faster pointer reaches null. Within a cycle its relative position advances by one per iteration and eventually equals the slower pointer.
walkthrough: For values [2,2,9] with tail link -1, the last node points to null. The repeated payload 2 does not imply a cycle: the two nodes are different objects. The fast pointer reaches the end, so return false.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for n reachable node objects.
